newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico bumper 31 mln tonne '96 grain crop - Zedillo.
newsitem.headline: Mexico bumper 31 mln tonne '96 grain crop - Zedillo.

text.p: Mexico's 1996 grain harvest will top 31 million tonnes to chalk up a record, said President Ernesto Zedillo on Wednesday.

"This year, meaning autumn-winter '95-'96 and spring-summer '96, we will have the highest grain harvest in the country's history," a news release quoted Zedillo as saying in a meeting with agricultural producers in the northern state of Chihuahua, which borders Texas.
Zedillo drew attention to efforts by the region's producers to overcome severe financial and weather conditions.
"Indeed, there were two droughts, one on top of the other, the natural drought which, as we know, has lasted for four years and the severe financial drought the country suffered in 1995," he said.
